id: 53_What are common examples of hazardous materials in daily life trending question
title: 日常生活中常见的危险物品
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/53_What are common examples of hazardous materials in daily life trending question.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/53_What are common examples of hazardous materials in daily life trending question/src.py

points.K9: 层层氧化，变成二氧化碳和水
points.K10: 烃类生物降解，治理油污

shots.scene: 欣欣站在宿舍和家里厨房拼成的背景前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a background combining a dorm room and a home kitchen, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 危险物品，不只在实验室里。
overlay: 日常生活中常见的危险物品

shots.scene: 五个家用物品图标排成一排，后面跟着一个微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: Five household item icons in a row, followed by a microbe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先看身边五类，再看吃油的微生物。

shots.scene: 周末，阿杰在宿舍打扫卫生，手里拿着两瓶空白标签的清洁剂
shots.prompt_en: On the weekend the young male student cleans his dorm, holding two cleaning bottles with blank labels.
shots.narration: 周末，阿杰在宿舍大扫除。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着桌上的清洁剂、充电宝和杀虫喷雾，头顶问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at cleaners, a power bank and an insect spray on his desk, with a question mark above him.
shots.narration: 他想：这些也算危险物品吗？

shots.scene: 小研从门口探头，点点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leans in at the door and nods.
shots.narration: 小研说：算！我们一样样看。

shots.scene: 家里的厨房、卫生间、车库三个场景图标，各有几个瓶罐
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a kitchen, a bathroom and a garage, each with a few bottles and cans. No people.
shots.narration: 家里和宿舍，也藏着危险物品。

shots.scene: 瓶罐背面放大，上面有小小的象形图
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the back of a household bottle showing small hazard pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 看看瓶子背面，就有警示。

shots.scene: 一瓶漂白剂和一瓶氨水味清洁剂并排
shots.prompt_en: A bleach bottle and an ammonia cleaner bottle side by side with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 第一类：清洁剂，比如漂白剂、氨水。

shots.scene: 汽油桶、液化气罐、煤油瓶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fuel can, an LPG cylinder and a kerosene bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 第二类：燃料，汽油、液化气、煤油。

shots.scene: 汽车蓄电池和手机锂电池两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a car lead-acid battery and a phone lithium-ion battery. No people.
shots.narration: 第三类：电池，铅酸电池和锂电池。

shots.scene: 杀虫喷雾和驱蚊液两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an insect spray can and a mosquito repellent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 第四类：杀虫剂和驱虫剂。

shots.scene: 药盒和药瓶图标，旁边胶囊
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a medicine box, a pill bottle and capsules. No people.
shots.narration: 第五类：药品，比如抗生素、化疗药。

shots.scene: 大海上一片油污，镜头推近到油滴里
shots.prompt_en: An oil slick on the sea; the view zooms in to a single oil droplet. No people.
shots.narration: 再说说：油污泄漏，微生物能帮忙。

shots.scene: 油滴周围聚集着杆状和球状的卡通微生物
shots.prompt_en: Cartoon rod-shaped and round microbes gather around the oil droplet. No people.
shots.narration: 有些细菌，专门分解石油烃。

shots.scene: 两个微生物图标下面贴着空白名牌
shots.prompt_en: Two microbe icons with blank name tags beneath them. No people.
shots.narration: 比如假单胞菌、食烷菌这类。

shots.scene: 微生物抱着一条长链分子，像在吃饭
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon microbe holds a long chain molecule like a meal. No people.
shots.narration: 它们把烃类当作食物。

shots.scene: 微生物身体里亮起电池和积木图标
shots.prompt_en: A battery icon and a building block icon light up inside the cartoon microbe. No people.
shots.narration: 既获取能量，又用来生长。

shots.section_title: 层层氧化，变成二氧化碳和水
shots.scene: 长链分子一步步被切短，变成小分子
shots.prompt_en: A long chain molecule is cut step by step into shorter pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 先把油氧化，变成脂肪酸。
overlay: 层层氧化，变成二氧化碳和水

shots.section_title: 层层氧化，变成二氧化碳和水
shots.scene: 小分子最后变成气泡和水滴
shots.prompt_en: The small pieces finally turn into bubbles and water droplets. No people.
shots.narration: 最后分解成二氧化碳和水。

shots.section_title: 烃类生物降解，治理油污
shots.scene: 海面油污逐渐变淡，海水恢复清澈
shots.prompt_en: The oil slick gradually fades and the sea becomes clear again. No people.
shots.narration: 这叫烃类生物降解。
overlay: 烃类生物降解，治理油污

shots.section_title: 烃类生物降解，治理油污
shots.scene: 老周在实验室的生物安全柜里观察培养皿
shots.prompt_en: The older man observes a petri dish inside a biosafety cabinet in the lab.
shots.narration: 它是治理油污的重要办法之一。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，五个物品图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard where five household item icons light up one by one.
shots.narration: 清洁剂、燃料、电池、杀虫剂、药品。

shots.scene: 微生物抱着油滴，油滴变成气泡和水
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon microbe hugs an oil droplet, which turns into bubbles and water.
shots.narration: 微生物吃油，变成二氧化碳和水。

shots.scene: 欣欣在干净的宿舍里向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye to the camera in a clean, tidy dorm room.
shots.narration: 实验室外也要讲安全，再见！
